entities.name: Query dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase
observations: 204-aa sequence has a 97.1%-coverage match to reviewed Bacillus subtilis dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase P94558 at 43.3% identity (E=5.66e-43); function is inferred by homology.

Likely Mg2+-dependent hydrolysis of noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates (dITP, XTP, ITP) to monophosphates and diphosphate, helping prevent aberrant nucleotide incorporation; exact substrate preference is not established for this query.

entities.name: Purine NTP catabolism
observations: Closest reviewed homolog is annotated to purine nucleoside triphosphate catabolic process (GO:0009146); association for the query is inferred from homology.
Related activities annotated for homologs include dITP, XTP and ITP diphosphatase activities (GO:0035870, GO:0036222, GO:0036220).
